summary: Hoth Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing that its subsidiary Rocket One entered into exclusive license agreements with Virginia Commonwealth University for patents in data center and AI cooling. The company also announced a planned name change to Rocket One, Inc. and a business restructuring to focus on this field. The agreements include mid-single-digit royalties on net sales and low-double-digit sublicensing revenue. Minimum annual payments start at low five figures. The restructuring signals a strategic pivot from pharmaceuticals. Watch for shareholder approval of the name change and further details on the restructuring plan, as the strategic shift may face execution risks.
